text:
kepler-ops: hey team — starting last night our dedicated pool kp-77 started returning sporadic 429s and P99 gen latency spiking to 2-3s. baseline ~120 QPS, short bursts up to ~800 QPS for 5-15s. filing because user-facing errors started around 21:30 UTC. cc @sarah (support)
sarah (support): hot take — can you paste pool id/window and whether these are auth errors or purely rate-limit 429s?
kepler-ops: pool kp-77, window 2026-03-15 21:30-22:00 UTC. logs show mostly 429: "throughput limit exceeded" and a few auth timeouts to our IdP. reserved capacity is 4x A100 equiv (min 2, max 6 replicas).
liam (eng-sre): sounds like autoscale lag + burst overshoot. what's your autoscale config and any warmup hooks?
kepler-ops: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=6; policy: scale_on_cpu 70%, cooldown 60s. no warmup. note: our prompts changed last week and avg tokens/req jumped ~2x, so compute per request doubled.
anya (runtime): that will do it — more tokens -> longer per-request GPU time -> effective throughput drops. can you paste a sample request + model and a small latency histogram?
kepler-ops: sure — sample request + log snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"<user prompt with long system tokens>"}'
```
logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:31:02Z ERROR 429 "throughput limit exceeded" request_id=abc123
2026-03-15T21:31:03Z ERROR 504 "auth timeout" request_id=abc124
2026-03-15T21:31:05Z INFO 200 "ok" request_id=abc125 latency=240ms tokens=980
```
sarah (support): we'll repro in sandbox. immediate mitigation: increase max_replicas to 12 or bump reserved pool temporarily and relax per-customer rate limits. warning: billing will increase.
mona (acct-mgmt): heads up kepler — any reserved change affects committed spend. do you want emergency pre-approval now?
kepler-ops: approved to bump to 8 replicas for 48h. also pls advise client-side retry strategy — we saw retry amplification when many clients retried immediately.
liam (eng-sre): good call. set client retry backoff to jittered 300-800ms with capped retries to avoid thundering herd. we'll also deploy an autoscale tweak: detect qps spike >2x baseline within 60s and pre-spin 2 extra nodes (predictive warmup).
deploy-bot: deploy started: autoscale-policy kp-77 updated by liam — 2323456830
anya (runtime): additionally enable prefix/token caching for repeated system prompts; runtime cache can cut compute by ~25-35% for common templates.
kepler-ops: thanks — after bump p99 dropped to ~180ms. what about the auth timeouts?
sarah (support): auth timeouts line up with IdP token endpoint being hammered. recommend local token caching or using Redwood service-account token refresh flow to reduce IdP dependence during spikes. I'll open a support ticket to coordinate with IdP.
kepler-ops: filed ticket SUP-5891. last item — will billing adjust for this emergency bump? mona?
mona (acct-mgmt): I'll run a one-time credit review if this was due to mis-estimated tokens/req + autoscale lag. please attach the final cost delta after the 48h window.
kepler-ops: will do, link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/customer/kepler/kp-77/metrics — p99 trending down after changes, monitoring for next 24h. :thumbsup:
